citation: Morishima T, Mori A, Sasaki H, et al. Impact of Exercise and Moderate Hypoxia on Glycemic Regulation and Substrate Oxidation Pattern. PLoS ONE. 2014.
protocol: Four 7.5 h trials (08:00-15:30): rest or 30 min pedalling at 60% VO2max at 08:00, 10:30, 13:00, in normoxia or hypoxia (FiO2 15%); standard meals at 08:30, 11:00, 13:30
population: n=8 sedentary overweight men, age 27+/-3 y, BMI 28.6+/-0.8, body fat 28.4%

reports.where: AUC in text; time courses in figures

note: Overweight men (flag). Only Table 1 is subject characteristics; data in text and figures. Use the normoxic rest and exercise trials; hypoxia arms are outside pulse (SpO2 input not in the cohort vocabulary).
